item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
Highlights

  • Your coding agent can build your Cai actions — connect Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex once; every proposal waits for your approval as a reviewable diff, then runs locally from ⌥C.
  • Cai shows its work — capability chips on every action, a Running pill, and results that always land somewhere.
  • Calendar & Contacts — actions can use them, with all macOS grants in Connections → System Access.

Also

  • Named secrets for shell actions, stored in the Keychain.
  • Mail, Notes, and Reminders destinations work again in the official build.
  • Failures no longer show a success checkmark, and shell actions can't hang.

item.title: Version 1.5.3
item.description:
Fixed

  • Model selection reverting on restart — Apple Intelligence (or any non-default model) now stays selected after you quit and relaunch Cai.

Full release notes →

item.title: Version 1.5.2
item.description:
Highlights

  • Press Return to send — optional Slack/ChatGPT-style submit in Ask AI (off by default).
  • Snappier, more reliable clipboard capture — Option+C no longer freezes on large items, and a copy made right before you quit is never lost.

Also fixes custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints ending in /v1.

Updating from 1.5.1 or earlier? Due to a signing-key change you'll need to download this one manually from getcai.app once. Auto-updates resume afterward.

Full release notes →

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: - Apple Intelligence compatibility - OCR: Image to text extraction - Follow-up conversations with AI - Create New Chats to ask AI anything (Cmd+N) - Clipboard history improvements (pin, search, up to 100 entries) - Shell-compatible custom actions - Community extensions (share via YAML, clipboard install) - Dark mode improvements - UI improvements and bug fixes

item.title: Version 1.5.1
item.description:
Highlights

  • Cloud LLM responses now stream — token-by-token for OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, and custom providers. No more 5–60 second spinner.
  • Long cloud outputs no longer truncated — Proofread and rewrite-style actions run to completion on cloud providers.

Plus better cancellation UX, longer cloud timeouts, higher token caps for thinking models, and shell tools find Homebrew binaries again.

Thanks to @akl773 for the cloud-truncation fix.

Full release notes →

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
Highlights

  • Action chaining — build multi-step workflows with custom actions, destinations, Apple Shortcuts, and inline LLM steps
  • Redesigned Actions and Destinations — tabbed Settings, drag-to-reorder, calmer palette
  • Make Cai yours — pin custom actions, hide built-ins you don't use

Plus inline LLM transforms, Apple Shortcuts as chain steps, markdown ticket bodies, and several Sentry-reported hang fixes.

Big thanks to @akl773 for the pin / hide built-ins contributions.

Full release notes →

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
Highlights

  • Bring your own key: OpenRouter + Anthropic — point Cai at Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or any of OpenRouter's 400+ models
  • Fire-and-forget workflows — Replace Selection destination (pinned to ⌘1) + auto-replace toggle on custom actions. A first taste of Cai running in the background.
  • Resizable main panel — drag any edge or corner, Cai remembers your size

Plus log redaction, paste-back reliability, MCP token fixes, and more.

Huge thanks to @kilabyte for the paste-back workflow, resizable panel, and OpenRouter provider contributions.

Full release notes →

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
Highlights

  • In-process MLX-Swift inference — replaces llama-server, ~15 MB lighter, native streaming, no zombie processes
  • Apple Intelligence support (macOS 26+) — fully on-device, ~36 MB vs ~2 GB RAM
  • Context Snippets v1 — per-app system prompts via ~/.config/cai/snippets.json
  • Type to reveal hidden actions — focused defaults, filter to surface anything

Existing users will be guided through a one-time GGUF → MLX migration on first launch (~1.8 GB download for Ministral 3B).

Full release notes →
